name: bring your own footage
note: A first-class path, not a fallback. Any clip with continuous camera motion works: Blender or C4D turntables, drone footage, existing client product video, After Effects renders. An agency with real footage gets a better page than any generative model produces, and this path makes the tool independent of any provider's pricing or availability.

pricing.note: Everything downstream of build/ is free: frame slicing, assembly and serving cost nothing.
